result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers make the same core fixes: real buttons with descriptive names, focus moved to the heading plus title updates on each view change, an alt text with the fares, and padding so the basket bar doesn't cover content. A also writes the missing step() function, so the basket total actually updates, and keeps the look closer to the original. B adds a visible 'Back to sailings' link and its own focus-ring colour, and its replaceState call strips the hash on load. B does give a more thorough list of what was wrong and what's left to do. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers make the same core fixes: real, named stepper buttons; focus moved to the heading plus a page-title update on each view swap; prices put in the image's alt text; and padding so the basket bar doesn't cover focused controls. B sticks closer to 'keep the look': it suggests a focus style and a back link but leaves them for the user to decide, and its hash routing copes with Back/Forward and a direct link to #checkout. A adds a visible back link and a focus colour it chose itself. B's main risks are writing its own step() function, which it does flag, and putting aria-labels on the live count spans.
